original_ai_output.title_zh: 纳萨拉瓦社区一名森林警卫人员据称遭杀害，居民悲痛愤怒
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚纳萨拉瓦州奥比地方政府区奥梅社区一名尼日利亚森林安全局人员劳伦斯·克莱图斯据称遭牧民杀害，居民对此表示悲痛与愤怒。据称，这名39岁警卫在试图逮捕入侵农田的牧民后遭到袭击。事件发生于周日下午5时30分左右，地点在社区河岸附近的农田。目前该事件为单一来源报道，具体细节尚未获得独立证实。

location.raw_text: Ome Community in Obi Local Government Area of Nasarawa State

key_facts.fact: 纳萨拉瓦州奥梅社区居民称对森林安全局人员劳伦斯·克莱图斯被杀感到悲痛
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Residents of Ome Community in Obi Local Government Area of Nasarawa State have said they are in pains and anguish over the killing of a personnel of the Nigeria Forest Security Service, Lawrence Cletus.

key_facts.fact: 据称这名警卫被牧民杀害
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Sources familiar with the circumstances of Cletus death, alleged that the guard was killed by the rampaging herdsmen in the community.

key_facts.fact: 39岁的克莱图斯据称在试图逮捕入侵农田的牧民后遭到袭击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Cletus, a 39-year-old man was said to have been attacked by the herdsmen for trying to arrest them after they invaded a farmland in the community with their cattles, causing severe damage.

key_facts.fact: 事件据称发生于周日下午5时30分左右，地点在社区河岸附近的农田
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the incident happened in the farm close to the river bank in the community at about 5:30 pm on Sunday.

uncertainties: 警卫被牧民杀害的说法为据称，尚未获得独立证实
事件具体经过仅有单一来源报道，缺乏交叉验证
袭击者身份及动机尚未确认
